from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re

root = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
output = Path('products/services/catalogue-download-fulfillment/redistribution-inventory.json')
marker = re.compile(r'\blicen[cs]e\b|copyright|SPDX|all rights reserved|attribution|redistribut', re.I)
files = []
for path in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
    if not path.is_file():
        continue
    data = path.read_bytes()
    lines = data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').splitlines()
    files.append({'path': str(path), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'bytes': len(data), 'possible_notice_file': bool(re.search(r'licen[cs]e|notice|copying|third.party', path.name, re.I)), 'matching_lines': [{'line': number, 'text': line.strip()[:350]} for number, line in enumerate(lines, 1) if marker.search(line)][:12]})
assert any(item['path'].endswith('/verify_example.py') for item in files), 'Candidate verifier missing from selected source'
result = {'scope': str(root), 'files': files, 'interpretation': 'Source inventory only. A matching line is a lead, and absent matches do not establish permissions. Verify controlling licenses and attribution for every essential file before packaging. This inventory does not establish checkout access.'}
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
readback = json.loads(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert readback == result
print(json.dumps({'output': str(output), 'files': len(files), 'notice_candidates': sum(item['possible_notice_file'] for item in files), 'files_with_matching_lines': sum(bool(item['matching_lines']) for item in files)}))
